advanced-filter-description: U ṱalula ha nṱha hu tendela u ṅwala maipfi a re na ndaela idzi: == != <= >= && || ( ) Tshikhala tshi fhambanya ndaela. Ni nga ṱalula fhethu hoṱhe ha data ho dzudzanywaho nga u ṅwala madzina na ndeme. Sa tsumbo: Field1 == Value1. Ṱhogomelani: Arali fhethu kana ndeme zwi na zwikhala, zwi vheeni vhukati ha zwiga zwa khotheisheni nthihi. Sa tsumbo: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. U pfuka zwiga zwa u langa (' \/), ni nga shumisa \. Sa tsumbo: Field1 == I\'m. Ni nga ṱanganya zwiimo zwinzhi. Sa tsumbo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Nga misi ndaela dzi ṱalutshedzwa u bva kha tsha monde u ya kha tsha u ḽa. Ni nga shandula mutevhe nga zwitangeli. Sa tsumbo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ni nga ṱoḓa fhethu ha maipfi nga regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-kanboard: Nambatedza Kanboard export JSON: tshithu tshi re na "columns" (kana mishumo i hwalaho column_name) na tshiṱaka "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns dzi vha mitevhe nahone mishumo i vha makhaḓi.
import-board-instruction-deck: Nambatedza NextCloud Deck board JSON (bodo ḽi re na "stacks", stack iṅwe na iṅwe i hwala "cards" dzayo). Stacks dzi vha mitevhe nahone makhaḓi a vha makhaḓi.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Nambatedza OpenProject work-packages collection JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses dzi vha mitevhe nahone work packages dzi vha makhaḓi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Nambatedza __sourceName__ issues JSON array (__endpoint__). Issues dzi vha makhaḓi o dzudzanywaho kha mitevhe ya Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Nambatedza Asana tasks export JSON ({ "data": [...] } u bva kha Asana export kana GET /tasks). Mishumo yo dzudzanywa kha zwipiḓa (memberships); mishumo yo fhelaho i ya kha Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Nambatedza ZenKit list export JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages dzi vha mitevhe nahone items dzi vha makhaḓi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Namatedza mutevhe wa mishumo ya markdown (nzila ine zwishumiswa zwa markdown-kanban zwo nga Obsidian Kanban zwi shumisaho): thoho dza "## Dzina ḽa mutevhe", na zwithu zwa "- [ ]"/"- [x]" fhasi. Thoho dzi vha mitevhe nahone zwithu zwi vha makhadi.
import-board-instruction-leo: Nambatedzani tshivhumbeo tsha Leo (faela ya .leo). Zwipiḓa zwa vhuimo ha nṱha zwi vha mitevhe, zwipiḓa zwi re fhasi hazwo thwii zwi vha garaṱa, nahone maṅwalwa a tshipiḓa a vha ṱhaluso ya garaṱa. Zwipiḓa zwa vhuimo ho dzikaho zwi vha mitevhe ya u ṱola. Zwipiḓa zwo swaiwaho zwi dzheniswa sa zwo fhedzwaho.
import-board-instruction-opml: Nambatedzani OPML outline, sa zwine Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq na zwiṅwe zwa outliner zwa i bvisela nnḓa. Zwithu zwa nṱha zwi vha mitevhe, vhana vhazwo vha vha khadi dzi re na noutu sa ṱhaluso, na zwithu zwa fhasi zwi vha mitevhe ya u sedza. Zwithu zwo fhelaho zwi dzheniswa sa zwo fhela.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Nambatedzani faela ya Org mode, sa zwine Emacs, Orgzly kana Beorg zwa i ṅwala. Ṱhoho dza nṱha dzi vha mitevhe na ṱhoho dza vhuvhili dzi vha khadi. TODO na DONE, ndeme, thegi, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE na CLOSED zwi a vhulungwa, na zwibogisi zwa u swaya na ṱhoho dza fhasi zwi vha mitevhe ya u sedza.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Nambatedzani faela ya todo.txt: mushumo muthihi kha mutaladzi muṅwe na muṅwe, sa zwine app ya todo.txt na app dzi tshimbilelanaho nayo zwa ṅwalisa zwone. Mishumo yo fhelaho ("x") i ya kha Yo fhela, +project na @context zwi vha dzilebulu, (A) i vha lebulu ya zwine zwa tea u thoma, ngeno due: na t: zwi tshi vha maḓuvha a u fhedza na a u thoma.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Nambatedzani mvelelo ya task export: mutevhe wa JSON, kana mushumo muthihi kha mutaladzi muṅwe na muṅwe. Mishumo yo fhelaho i ya kha Done, project na priority zwi shanduka zwa vha dziḽeibuḽu, annotations i shanduka ya vha mihumbulo, nahone depends i shanduka ya vha vhushaka ha u ḓitika nga mishumo ine ya khou thivhela uyu mushumo.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Vulani faela ya .boardarchive ni nambatedze board.jsonl ya bodo, i na mutaladzi wa nzudzanyo kana i si nawo. Tshivhumbeo tsha u kuvhanganya nga zwigwada kha mbonalo ya bodo tshi shanduka tsha vha mitevhe, zwiṅwe zwivhumbeo zwa u nanga zwi shanduka zwa vha dziḽeibuḽu, zwipiḓa zwa maṅwalwa na mabogisi a u maka zwi shanduka zwa vha ṱhaluso na mutevhe wa u ṱola, nahone mihumbulo a a vhulungwa. Zwifanyiso na zwiambataniswa a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-todoist: Kha Todoist, vulani phurodzheke, nangani menyu ya ⋯ i re nṱha kha tshauri, nga murahu Manage data > Export as CSV, ni nambatedze faela ya CSV. Zwipiḓa zwi vha mitevhe, mishumo i vha makhadi, mishumo miṱuku i vha mutevhe wa u sedza, zwiṱodzi zwi vha mihumbulo, nahone @labels na zwi ṱanganedzwaho u thoma p1 u swika p3 zwi vha dziḽeibuḽu.
import-board-instruction-planner: Kha Microsoft Planner, vulani pulane, nangani menyu ya ⋯ i re tsini na dzina ḽayo, nga murahu Export as Excel (kha Planner ya kale: Export plan to Excel), ni nange iyo faela ya .xlsx. Buckets dzi vha mitevhe nahone mishumo i vha makhadi, na vho avhelwaho mushumo, maḓuvha, dziḽeibuḽu, mutevhe wa u sedza na ṱhaluso zwazwo; Progress, Priority na Completed By zwi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Kha MeisterTask, kiḽikani dzina ḽa phurodzhege, nangani Export project ni bvisele nnḓa CSV, ni kone u i nambatedza. Zwipiḓa zwi vha mitevhe na mishumo i vha khadi, na noutu dzayo, ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza, o avhelwaho mushumo na thegi; mishumo yo fhelaho i vhulunga ḓuvha ḽa u fhela. CSV yo ṅwalelwaho u dzhenisa ha MeisterTask hone i a shuma.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Kha Obsidian, vulani faela ya bodo ya Kanban sa Markdown (kana ni vule faela ya .md kha editha ya maṅwalwa), ni kone u i nambatedza yoṱhe. Ḽaini dzi vha mitevhe na mikano ya khadi yadzo, khadi dzi vhulunga thegi dzadzo, maḓuvha, ndeme, fhethu na mutevhe wa u sedza, na Archive i vha khadi dzo iswaho fhethu ha u vhulunga.
import-board-instruction-linear: Kha Linear, bviselani nnḓa mafhungo sa CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, kana u bvisela nnḓa ha view), ni kone u nambatedza CSV. Zwiimo zwi vha mitevhe, thimu dzi vha ḽaini, na mafhungo a vha khadi na o avhelwaho mushumo, ḽeibuḽu, maḓuvha, mafhungo a vhubebi, ndeme, khakhathelo, phurodzhege na tshifhinga.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Kha TickTick, vulani Settings, Account, Backup & Import ni ite backup, ni kone u nambatedza faela ya CSV. Mutevhe muṅwe na muṅwe wa TickTick u vha ḽaini na kholomu dzawo dzi vha mitevhe; mishumo i vhulunga thegi dzayo, maḓuvha, mutevhe wa u sedza, ndeme na mishumo miṱuku.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Kha ClickUp, bviselani nnḓa mishumo sa CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, kana u bvisela nnḓa ha List kana Table view na kholomu dzoṱhe), ni kone u nambatedza CSV. Zwiimo zwi vha mitevhe, mitevhe ya ClickUp i vha ḽaini, na mishumo i vha khadi na mishumo miṱuku yayo, vho avhelwaho mushumo, thegi, maḓuvha, ndeme na tshifhinga.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Kha Nullboard, vulani bodo, nangani Export this board... kha menyu, vulani faela ya .nbx kha editha ya maṅwalwa ni nambatedze zwi re ngomu. Mitevhe i vha mitevhe na noutu dzi vha khadi: mutevhe wa u thoma wa noutu ndi ṱhoho ya khadi na zwo salaho ndi ṱhaluso yayo. Noutu ya raw i wana ḽeibuḽu raw. Faela i re na bodo nnzhi i dzhenisa bodo yayo ya u thoma.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Kha Kanri, vulani Import & Export ni nange Export individual board (kana Export all data), ni kone u nambatedza faela ya .json. Kholomu dzi vha mitevhe na khadi dzi vha khadi, na ṱhaluso yadzo, ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza, thegi na mivhala; mishumo ya khadi i vha mutevhe wa u sedza. Kha u bvisela nnḓa data yoṱhe ho dzheniswa bodo ya u thoma.
import-board-instruction-planka: Ṅwalani aḓirese ya Planka yaṋu (tsumbo https://planka.example.com), dzina ḽa mushumisi na phasiwede ya Planka, nga murahu ni putedze "Sumbedza mutevhe". Zwi shumiswa fhedzi u dzhia bodo nahone a zwi vhulungwi. Khethani bodo ni putedze "Dzhia": WeKan i i vhala u bva kha API ya Planka, khathihi na mitevhe, garaṱa, ṱhaluso, maḓuvha a u fhedza, zwiga, miraḓo, mitevhe ya mishumo na mihumbulo, nga murahu ni bvele phanḓa na u dzhenisa sa zwa ḓuvha na ḓuvha. Garaṱa dzi re fhethu ha u vhulunga ha Planka dzi dzheniswa dzo vhulungwa; zwo nambatedzwaho na garaṱa dzi re kha tshikwama tsha matshika a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Kha Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), dzhenani, tendelani thendelo ya Tasks.Read nahone ni kopolole token kha thebe ya Access token. I nambatedzeni fhano ni putedze "Sumbedza mutevhe"; token i shumiswa fhedzi kha u dzhia uhu nahone a i vhulungwi. Khethani mitevhe yoṱhe kana mutevhe muthihi ni putedze "Dzhia". Mutevhe muṅwe na muṅwe wa To Do u vha mutevhe nahone mushumo muṅwe na muṅwe u vha garaṱa, na zwiṅwalwa zwawo, maḓuvha a u fhedza na a u thoma, maga sa mutevhe wa u ṱola, zwigwada sa zwiga, ndeme ya nṱha na tshiimo sa zwiga; mishumo yo fhedzwaho i vhulungwa. Zwihumbudzi na u dovholola a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Kha KanbanFlow, vulani menu ya bodo, khethani Settings → API & Webhooks nahone ni kopolole API token ya bodo. Nambatedzani token fhano, putedzani "Sumbedza mutevhe", khethani bodo ni putedze "Dzhia"; token i shumiswa fhedzi kha u dzhia uho nahone a i vhulungwi. Kholomu dzi vha mitevhe nahone nḓila dza mushumo dzi dzula dzi nḓila dza mushumo; mishumo i vhulunga ṱhaluso, muvhala, zwiga, ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza, mishumwana sa mutevhe wa u ṱola, tshifhinga tsho shumiswaho, khakhathelo, vhathu na mihumbulo.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Ṅwalani ID ya akhaunthu yaṋu ya Basecamp (nomboro i tevhelaho basecamp.com/ kha aḓirese) na token ya u swikelela (u bva kha app ya OAuth 2 yo ṅwaliswaho kha launchpad.37signals.com, kana ine ṱhanganyiso i re hone ya vha i nayo), putedzani "Sumbedza mutevhe", khethani thandela ni putedze "Dzhia". Token i shumiswa fhedzi kha u dzhia uho nahone a i vhulungwi. Ṱafula ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽa garaṱa ḽi vha nḓila ya mushumo ine kholomu dzayo dza vha mitevhe, nahone mitevhe ya zwine zwa tea u itwa i vha nḓila ya mushumo ya "To-dos"; garaṱa na zwine zwa tea u itwa zwi vhulunga maṅwalwa, maḓuvha, vho ṋewaho mushumo na mihumbulo, maga a garaṱa a vha mutevhe wa u ṱola, nahone zwo fhedzwaho zwi vhulungwa.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Wanani token ya u swikelela kha OAuth 2.0 Playground: fhasi ha Tasks API v1 khethani tasks.readonly, putedzani Authorize APIs, nga murahu Exchange authorization code for tokens, ni kopolole access token. I nambatedzeni fhano ni putedze "Sumbedza mutevhe", khethani mitevhe yoṱhe ya mishumo kana muthihi, nga murahu "Dzhia". Token i shumiswa fhedzi kha u dzhia uhu nahone a i vhulungwi. Mitevhe ya mishumo i vha mitevhe nahone mishumo i vha garaṱa, na zwiṅwalwa, vhukwamani na ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza; mishumwana i vha mutevhe wa u ṱola nahone mishumo yo fhedzwaho i dzheniswa yo vhulungwa.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API ya Google Keep ndi ya akhaunthu dza Google Workspace fhedzi. Wanani token ya u swikelela ya OAuth 2.0 i re na scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (kha OAuth 2.0 Playground arali mulanguli wa Workspace a tshi tendela, kana u bva kha service account i re na u rumela ha domain yoṱhe), i nambatedzeni, putedzani "Sumbedza mutevhe" nga murahu "Dzhia". Token i shumiswa fhedzi kha u dzhia uhu nahone a i vhulungwi. Zwiṅwalwa zwa maipfi zwi vha garaṱa kha mutevhe wa "Notes", nahone zwiṅwalwa zwa mutevhe wa u ṱola zwi vha garaṱa kha mutevhe wa "Lists" na zwithu zwazwo sa mutevhe wa u ṱola. Zwiṅwalwa zwi re kha matshika, zwo nambatedzwaho na u kovhekana a zwi dzheniswi.
api-import-desc: I dzhieni kha tshumelo nga akhaunthu yaṋu. Zwine na zwi ṅwala fhano zwi shumiswa fhedzi kha u dzhia uhu nahone a zwi vhulungwi.
api-import-fetched: Zwo dzhiiwa. Ṱolani miraḓo i re fhasi ni dzhenise.
api-import-nothing: A hu na tshithu tsha u dzhenisa nga akhaunthu iyi.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Kha Pivotal Tracker, vulani thebu ya MORE ya phurodzhege ni nange Export CSV (kana ni nange story ni nange Bulk Actions, CSV), ni kone u nambatedza CSV. Tshiimo tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha story tshi vha mutevhe na story dzi vha khadi, na lushaka lwadzo na ḽeibuḽu, vhaṋe, muṱoḓi, maḓuvha, mihumbulo, mishumo na zwithivheli; Estimate i vha Story points na iteration dzi vha sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Kha Tasks.org, vulani Settings, Backups ni nange Export tasks, ni kone u nambatedza zwi re ngomu ha faela iyo ya .json. Mitevhe i vha mitevhe na mishumo i vha khadi, na noutu dzayo, thegi, maḓuvha, mihumbulo na mishumo miṱuku; mishumo yo fhelaho i vhulunga ḓuvha ḽa u fhela, na ndeme i vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-monday: Kha monday.com, vulani menyu wa bodo, nangani More actions na Export board to Excel (na updates na subitems arali ni tshi ṱoḓa), ni kone u nanga faela iyo ya .xlsx. Kholomu ya Status i vha mitevhe na zwigwada zwi vha ḽaini; vhathu, maḓuvha, timeline na thegi zwi dzula fhethu hazwo, kholomu dziṅwe dzi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho na updates dzi vha mihumbulo.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Kha Super Productivity, vulani Settings, nga murahu Sync & Backup, nangani Export Data ni nambatedze zwi re ngomu ha faela ya sp-backup .json. Phurodzhege iṅwe na iṅwe i vha ḽaini na mishumo i vha khadi kha To Do, In Progress, Backlog kana Done, na noutu dzayo, thegi, ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza, tshifhinga tsho shumiswaho na mishumo miṱuku; mishumo yo iswaho fhethu ha u vhulunga i vha khadi dzo iswaho fhethu ha u vhulunga.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Kha Taiga, vulani Admin > Project > Export ni dauniḽoude dump ya phurodzhege (bvulani faela ya .json.gz u thoma), ni kone u nambatedza JSON yayo. Zwiimo zwa user story zwi vha mitevhe, user story dzi vha khadi na mishumo yadzo sa mishumo miṱuku, epic na mafhungo zwi wana ḽaini dzazwo, na sprint, thegi, mihumbulo na custom attributes zwi ḓa nazwo. Zwiṱumetshedzwa a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Kha Vikunja, vulani Settings, nangani Data Export ni dauniḽoude faela ya .zip ine ya ni rumela yone, ni kone u nanga faela iyo, kana ni nambatedze data.json i re ngomu hayo. Kanban bucket dzi vha mitevhe na mishumo i vha khadi, na ḽeibuḽu dzayo, vho avhelwaho mushumo, maḓuvha, ṱhaluso, mitevhe ya mishumo sa mitevhe ya u sedza na mihumbulo; ndeme, phesenthe yo fhelaho na done zwi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho. Zwiṱumetshedzwa a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-quire: Kha Quire, vulani menyu wa phurodzhege ni nange Export CSV, ni kone u nambatedza CSV. Zwiimo zwi vha mitevhe na mishumo i vha khadi, na mishumo miṱuku yayo sa khadi dza vhana, vho avhelwaho mushumo, thegi sa ḽeibuḽu, maḓuvha a u thoma, a u fhedza na a u fhela, ṱhaluso na ndeme sa fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho. Mihumbulo na zwiṱumetshedzwa a zwi kha CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Kha Wrike, bviselani nnḓa phurodzhege kana fodara kha Excel, kana ni ḓadze themphuḽeithi ya Excel ya u dzhenisa ya Wrike, ni kone u nanga faela iyo ya .xlsx. Mitevhe ya fodara na phurodzhege i vha ḽaini, Status i vha mitevhe na mishumo i vha khadi, na Key yayo, mushumo wa vhubebi, vho avhelwaho mushumo, maḓuvha a u thoma na a u fhela, zwi tshi ḓitika na ṱhaluso; Priority, Duration na kholomu dziṅwe dzi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Kha Teamwork.com, ḓadzani themphuḽeithi ya Excel ya u dzhenisa mishumo (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ni i vhulunge sa .xlsx, ni kone u nanga faela iyo. Mitevhe ya mishumo i vha mitevhe na mishumo i vha khadi; mushumo u thomaho nga -, # kana > u vha mushumo muṱuku wa mushumo u re nṱha hawo (--, ## kana >> vhuimo vhuthihi fhasi). Vho avhelwaho mushumo, maḓuvha na thegi zwi dzula fhethu hazwo; Priority, Estimated time na Complete zwi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Kha Businessmap (ḽine ḽa vha Kanbanize kale), vulani Advanced Search, nangani Configure results u nanga kholomu, dauniḽodani faela ya Excel, ni kone u nanga faela iyo ya .xlsx. Kholomu dzi vhalwa nga madzina adzo a Luisimane (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): arali akhaunthu yaṋu i tshi shumisa luṅwe luambo, shandukisani madzina a mutevhe wa ṱhoho a vhe nga Luisimane u thoma. Column i vha mitevhe na Lane i vha ḽaini; vhaṋe, thegi, muvhala, maḓuvha, mihumbulo na linki dza vhubebi zwi dzula fhethu hazwo, na Priority, Size, Type na kholomu dziṅwe zwi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Kha Redmine, vulani Issues dza phurodzhege, nangani Also available in: CSV fhasi ha mutevhe, nangani kholomu (All columns, na Description) ni bvisele nnḓa, ni kone u nambatedza CSV. Redmine i ṋea kholomu madzina nga luambo lwaṋu, nga zwenezwo vhewani luambo lwaṋu lu vhe Luisimane kha My account ni sa athu bvisela nnḓa. Tshiimo tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshi vha mutevhe na mafhungo a vha khadi, na tracker sa ḽeibuḽu, o avhelwaho mushumo, muṅwali, maḓuvha, mushumo wa vhubebi na mafhungo a elanaho; ndeme, khethekanyo, vesheni ye ya livhiswa, tshifhinga tsho khakhathelwaho, % Done na fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho zwi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho.
import-board-instruction-notion: Kha Notion, vulani database sa siaṱari ḽoṱhe, nangani ••• na Export, nangani Markdown & CSV, ni nange faela ya .zip ine ya dauniḽouda, kana database CSV nthihi u bva khayo, kana ni nambatedze CSV iyo. Kholomu i re na dzina ḽa Status i vha mitevhe (arali i siho, kholomu ya u thoma i vhonalaho sa select i a ita zwenezwo, na muvhigo wa u dzhenisa u amba uri ndi ifhio); mitevhe i vha khadi na ṱhoho yadzo, thegi sa ḽeibuḽu, vhathu sa miraḓo, maḓuvha, na maṅwalwa a siaṱari sa ṱhaluso; kholomu dziṅwe dzi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho. Vhushaka, zwifanyiso na zwiṱumetshedzwa a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-plane: Kha Plane, vulani Workspace Settings, nangani Exports, bviselani nnḓa phurodzhege sa JSON, CSV kana Excel ni dauniḽoude faela ya .zip, ni kone u nanga faela iyo, kana faela nthihi u bva ngomu hayo, kana ni nambatedze JSON kana CSV. Zwiimo zwi vha mitevhe, phurodzhege dzi vha ḽaini, na mafhungo a vha khadi na tshiṱalusi tshayo, vhubebi, vho avhelwaho mushumo, ḽeibuḽu, maḓuvha, linki na mihumbulo; ndeme, khakhathelo, cycle na module zwi vha fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho. U bvisela nnḓa ha Plane a hu na ṱhaluso kana zwiṱumetshedzwa, nga zwenezwo a zwi dzheniswi.
import-board-instruction-trello: Kha bodo yaṋu ya Trello, iyani kha 'Menu', nga murahu 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', ni kope maipfi o bviswaho.
import-board-instruction-csv: Nambatedzani ndeme dzaṋu dzo fhambanywaho nga khoma (CSV)/thebe (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Nambatedza JSON u bva kha Jira Cloud REST API issue search (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), kana tshithu tshi eḓanaho { "issues": [...] }. Jira statuses dzi vha mitevhe nahone issues dzi vha makhaḓi. Arali ni tama, dzhenisani array ya "automationRules" u itela u dzhenisa milayo.
import-board-instruction-excel: Khetha spreadsheet ya WeKan ya .xlsx (columns dzi fanaho na Excel export: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, madatumu, custom fields). Mutalo wa u thoma ndi ṱhoho.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Kha bodo yaṋu ya Kanban, iyani kha 'Menu', nga murahu 'Export board', ni kope maipfi a faela yo dauniloudiwaho.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Arali ni wana vhukhakhi musi ni tshi dzhenisa bodo ya Kanban, nga zwiṅwe zwifhinga u dzhenisa hu kha ḓi shuma nahone bodo i vha kha siaṱari ḽa Bodo dzoṱhe.
import-without-mapping-members: Dzhenisa hu si na u mepa miraḓo (mepa nga murahu)
import-members-mode-map: Nangani mushumisi o no vhaho kha muṅwe na muṅwe wavho
import-members-mode-placeholder: Vha vhulungeni sa vhashumisi vha fhethu na madzina avho, u vha ṱumanya na vhashumisi vha vhukuma nga murahu
import-members-mode-me: Vha iteni vhoṱhe vha vhe nṋe
csv-mapping-description: Nangani kholomu ya faela i farelaho fhethu huṅwe na huṅwe ha khadi. Khetho dzo itwa u bva kha madzina a kholomu; shandukisani dziṅwe dzi re na vhukhakhi, ni nange (not in the file) kha fhethu hu si kho kha faela.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Faela a i na kholomu ya mutevhe. Nangani nthihi nṱha, kana ni ṅwale dzina ḽa mutevhe muthihi une khadi iṅwe na iṅwe ya ya khawo.
csv-mapping-list-name: Mutevhe wa khadi iṅwe na iṅwe
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Kholomu dziṅwe dza u dzhenisa sa fhethu ha data ho dzudzanywaho ha maṅwalwa:
csv-mapping-boards: Shithi iṅwe na iṅwe i vha bodo yayo:
csv-mapping-title-required: Nangani kholomu i farelaho ṱhoho dza khadi.
csv-mapping-list-required: Ṅwalani dzina ḽa mutevhe une khadi iṅwe na iṅwe ya ya khawo, kana ni nange kholomu i farelaho mutevhe.
invalid-import-mapping: U ṱumanya kholomu a zwi tendelani na faela.
import-many-boards-hint: Nangani faela nnzhi dza u bvisela nnḓa dza tshishumiswa itshi, kana .zip nthihi i dzi farelaho: faela iṅwe na iṅwe i vha bodo yayo, yo dzheniswaho hu si na u ṱumanya miraḓo. .zip ine ya vha u bvisela nnḓa huthihi (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, kana WeKan na zwiṱumetshedzwa) ndi bodo nthihi. Musi faela dzo nangwa fhano, Import i dzi dzhenisa nṱhani ha fhethu ha nṱha.
import-one-board-per-project: Bodo nthihi kha phurodzhege iṅwe na iṅwe
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Ḽaini iṅwe na iṅwe ine u dzhenisa ha nga i ita (phurodzhege, fodara kana mutevhe wa tshishumiswa) i vha bodo yayo. Khadi dza vhubebi na zwi ḓitikaho vhukati ha bodo idzo zwo ṅwalwa kha muvhigo wa u dzhenisa.
export-all-boards-hint: Bodo iṅwe na iṅwe ine na kona u i bvisela nnḓa, kha u dauniḽouda huthihi: Excel sa bugu ya mushumo nthihi i re na shithi kha bodo iṅwe na iṅwe yo ṋewaho dzina ḽayo, fomati iṅwe na iṅwe sa .zip i re na faela kha bodo iṅwe na iṅwe.
import-json-placeholder: Nambatedzani data yaṋu yo teaho ya JSON afha
import-csv-placeholder: Nambatedzani data yaṋu yo teaho ya CSV/TSV afha
import-json-file: Kana khetha faela ya Trello JSON
import-attachments-zip: Trello attachments ZIP (a i ṱhogei, u bva kha Trello Card Attachments Downloader)

globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - makhadi a re na ḓuvha ḽa u guma

globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - makhadi kha bodo dza Kanban dza phuraivethe fhedzi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - hune *<field>* ya vha iṅwe ya `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` kana `__predicate_member__`. U vhea `-` phanḓa ha *<field>* hu ṱoḓa u sa vha na ndeme kha fhethu honoho (sa `has:-due` i ṱoḓa makhadi a si na ḓuvha ḽa u fhedzwa).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - hune *<sort-name>* ya vha iṅwe ya `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` kana `__predicate_modified__`. U dzudzanya u bva nṱha u ya fhasi, vheani `-` phanḓa ha dzina ḽa u dzudzanya.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - hune *<n>* ya vha nomboro yo fhelelaho i re nṱha ha zero i sumbedzaho tshivhalo tsha makhadi a u sumbedza kha siaṱari ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Ndaela dzi fanaho dzi ṱanganywa nga *OR* (kana). Hu ḓo bviswa makhadi ane a tevhela tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha zwiimo.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` i bvisa makhadi kha mutevhe une dzina ḽawo ḽa vha *Blocked* kana *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Ndaela dzi sa fani dzi ṱanganywa nga *AND* (na). Hu bviswa fhedzi makhadi ane a tevhela zwiimo zwoṱhe. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` i bvisa fhedzi makhadi kha mutevhe *Available* a re na ḽeibuḽu *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Maḓuvha a nga ṅwalwa sa nomboro yo fhelelaho i re nṱha kana fhasi ha zero, kana nga `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` kana `__predicate_year__` kha tshifhinga tsha zwino.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: U ṱoḓa maipfi a hu sedzi vhuhulwane ha maḽeḓere.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Nga nḓila ya u thoma, makhadi o vhulungwaho ha ṱoḓiwi.

database-migration-description: Pfulusela data ya maṅwalwa (zwoṱhe nga nnḓa ha zwo namaṱheliswaho na avatar, zwine zwa sala kha filesystem) vhukati ha MongoDB na FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Iṅwe database i tea u vha i tshi khou shuma nahone i tshi swikelelwa (maphothi a mvelaphanḓa: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; shandula nga WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Nga murahu ha musi ho fhela, sedzisa MONGO_URL kha iṅwe database nahone thoma hafhu WeKan (kha Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb kana =mongodb).

sandstorm-migration-description: Musi WeKan i tshi shuma ngomu kha Sandstorm grain, database yayo ya kale ya MongoDB 3 i pfuluselwa kha FerretDB v1 (SQLite) kha u thoma u vulwa, nahone zwo namaṱheliswaho na avatar zwi pfuluselwa u bva kha database zwi ya kha thumba dza grain dza files/attachments na files/avatars. Hezwi zwi sumbedza arali u pfulusela ho bvelela nahone tshikhala tshingafhani tsha disiki tshine faela ya kale ya raw ya MongoDB database tshi tshi ḓi shumisa ngomu kha grain, nahone zwi ni tendela u thutha faela idzo dza raw u itela u vhofholola tshikhala.

Fhethu hu songo swaywaho hu dzumbululwa kha khadi iṅwe na iṅwe, khadi ṱhukhu na Nzudzanyo dza Bodo / Khadi dza bodo iṅwe na iṅwe. A hu na data ya khadi kana nzudzanyo ya bodo zwi shandukaho, na u hu swaya hafhu hu sumbedza bodo iṅwe na iṅwe nga he ya vha yo dzudzanywa ngaho. Ndaela ya fhethu ndi ya bodo iṅwe na iṅwe.

cards-loading-description: Nḓila ine bodo ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽa layisha makhaḓi aḽo. Makhaḓi oṱhe: khaḓi ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe ḽi layishelwa kha buraweza (zwa u leluwa, zwiitwa zwoṱhe zwi a shuma, fhedzi bodo ḽi re na maḓana a makhaḓi ḽi rumela data nnzhi kha muvhoni muṅwe na muṅwe). Lazy: mutevhe muṅwe na muṅwe u layisha fhedzi makhaḓi a vhonalaho zwino (infinite scroll) na muvhalo u tshilaho, ngauralo mabodo mahulwane vhukuma a shumisa memori na bandwidth i ṱhukhu. Zwi dovha zwa vhewa nga CARDS_LOADING environment variable.
cards-loading-lazy-note: U layisha makhaḓi nga lazy ndi zwa u lingwa: dzikhaunthara dza makhaḓi na WIP limits ndi dza vhukuma, fhedzi Calendar/Table/Gantt views na multi-select zwi sumbedza fhedzi makhaḓi o layishwaho u swika zwino. Layisha hafhu mabodo o vulwaho nga murahu ha u shandula hezwi.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Musi zwo vulwa, dzilinki dzoṱhe (zwivhili markdown links dzi ngaho [label](url) na raw HTML <a href> tags) dzi dzula dzi tshi sumbedzwa sa maṅwalwa fhedzi, a dzi puṱedzei kha tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshiṱaka tsha maṅwalwa (dzithero na ṱhalutshedzo dza bodo na khaḓi, mibono, tshekilisiti, na zwiṅwe). Hezwi zwi thivhela dzilinki dzi xedzaho dzi puṱedzeaho. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa, ngauralo dzilinki dzi dzula dzi tshi puṱedzea.
always-show-code-as-text: Sumbedza misi yoṱhe khoudu yoṱhe sa maṅwalwa fhedzi
always-show-code-as-text-description: Musi zwo vulwa, maṅwalwa a rich text a hongo sumbedzwa sa markdown kana HTML: tshiko tshoṱhe tshi dzula tshi tshi sumbedzwa sa maṅwalwa fhedzi kha tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshiṱaka tsha maṅwalwa (dzithero na ṱhalutshedzo dza bodo na khaḓi, mibono, tshekilisiti, na zwiṅwe). Hezwi zwi bvisela khagala zwidzhena zwo dzumbiwaho — HTML comments (<!-- -->), tshine markdown links tsha nanga, JavaScript na iṅwe khoudu iṅwe na iṅwe — ngauralo khoudu yoṱhe i dzula i tshi vhonala, a i puṱedzei, nahone a i shumi. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa, ngauralo markdown i sumbedzwa nga ho teaho.
disable-all-import-description: Musi zwo vulwa, zwiitwa zwoṱhe zwa u dzhenisa zwi a dzimiwa: u dzhenisa bodo u bva kha WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea na Forgejo, na u kopa bodo. Zwikhetho zwa menyu ya u dzhenisa zwi a dzumbiwa nahone seva i hana khumbelo iṅwe na iṅwe ya u dzhenisa. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa.
disable-all-export-description: Musi zwo vulwa, zwiitwa zwoṱhe zwa u bvisela nnda zwi a dzimiwa: u bvisela nnda bodo sa WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, kana kha NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, na u bvisela nnda tsho namaṱheliswaho tshithihi. Zwikhetho zwa menyu ya u bvisela nnda zwi a dzumbiwa nahone seva i hana khumbelo iṅwe na iṅwe ya u bvisela nnda. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa.
disable-import-avatars-description: Musi zwo vulwa, avatar (zwifanyiso zwa phurofaela ya vhashumisi) a zwi dzheniswi. Hezwi zwi katela u dzhenisa WeKan JSON, u dzhenisa Trello, na u ṱanganyisa avatar u bva kha vhaṋei vha vhuḓivhi vha nnḓa kha u dzhena (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Madzina na iṅwe data zwi kha ḓi dzheniswa; ndi avatar fhedzi dzi fhiraho. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa.
disable-export-avatars-description: Musi zwo vulwa, avatar (zwifanyiso zwa phurofaela ya vhashumisi) a zwi katelwi musi u tshi bvisela nnda bodo (WeKan JSON na CSV export). Madzina a vhashumisi na iṅwe data zwi kha ḓi bviselwa nnda; ndi avatar fhedzi dzi siiwaho. Mvelaphanḓa yo dzimwa.

backup-description: Ita bakapu ya Zwo Namaṱheliswaho, Avatar na/kana Data (collections dzoṱhe dza maṅwalwa dzi si dzo namaṱheliswaho kana avatar). .zip i rumelwa nga u ṱavhanya kha vhuvhulungo ho nangiwaho — hu si na faela ya tshifhinganyana — sa backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, i re na YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars na /data. Vhuvhulungo ha cloud (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) vhu shumisa credentials dzo dzudzanywaho kha dzithebe dzavho dza vhuvhulungo.

Vhuṱumani ha kale vhu nga vha vhu si na mathomo a ḓivheaho. Makhadi o thuthiwaho a ṱoḓa zwifanyiso zwa ḓivhazwakale zwo vhulungwaho. Zwiitisi zwi dzhenelanaho zwi vhalwa zwo fhambana.

Maḓuvha ndi nyanganyelo dza tshipiḓa tsha nṱha; zwivhalo ndi u ḓiimisela ha tshipiḓa tsha fhasi. Zwi humbulela uri mushumo u ḓo fhela nga nḓila i fanaho; a si khwaṱhisedzo. Mukano muhulwane: maḓuvha a 3,650. Arali hu si na mushumo wo fhelaho, a hu na nyanganyelo.
flow-note-processBehavior: Tshifhinga tsha tshiimo tshi shumisa Mathomo, kana ḓuvha ḽa u sikwa arali a siho, na Magumo, kana u vhulungwa arali a siho. XmR i sumbedza ndeme nthihi nthihi na phambano dzi tevhekanaho, na vhukati na mikano ya mvelo ya kushumele; hu ṱoḓea mishumo i si fhasi ha mivhili yo fhelaho nga nḓila yo teaho.

Nyanganyelo dzi siho na maḓuvha a songo teaho a a litshwa. Arali hu si na mathomo, hu shumiswa ḓuvha ḽa u sikwa; arali hu si na magumo, hu shumiswa u vhulungwa.

email-recovery-description: Muduba muthihi kha muṱanganedzi muṅwe na muṅwe. Ṱoḓani nga ID ya mushumisi. Zwi re kha milaedza na zwipiḓa zwa imeyili ya muṱanganedzi a zwi sumbedzwi. U imisa lwa tshifhinganyana hu fara milaedza i re hone na ine ya ḓo ḓa; u isa phanḓa hu lingedza u rumela milaedza ya mutevhe zwino. U khansela hu bvisa milaedza yo dzheniswaho kha mutevhe u swika tshifhingani tsha khumbelo. Arali u rumela hu tshi khou bvela phanḓa, lingedzani hafhu nga murahu ha tshifhinganyana. Mulaedza wo no thomaho u rumelwa a u koni u humiselwa murahu, nahone u rumela hu sa khwaṱhisedzwaho hu nga dovhololwa. U kundelwa ha tshoṱhe na milaedza yo swikaho kha tshivhalo tsha ndingedzo tsho vhewaho zwi dzula zwo vhulungwa u itela u ṱoliwa. U lingedza hafhu milaedza yo kundelwaho hu thoma mutevhe muswa wa ndingedzo nahone hu vhulunga u imiswa lwa tshifhinganyana hu re hone.

sync-planning-hint: Sprint na khanḓiso zwi elaniswa fhedzi musi Scrum yo thomiwa kha bodo iyi. Sprint kana khanḓiso i si ho i itwa kha bodo iyi, na maḓuvha ane tshisima tsha a ṋea; i re hone i elaniswa nga ID ya tshisima u thoma, nga murahu nga dzina. Tshanduko ya henefha ya u dzudzanya i dzula u swika tshisima tshi tshi shandukisa u dzudzanya ha mafhungo ayo, na Sync ya u thoma a i bvisi u dzudzanya.
activity-recovery-description: Nḓivhadzo dzi songo fhelaho dzi lingedzwa hafhu nga u ḓiitela. Sedzulusani nyito dzi si ho kana dzo shandukaho ni sa athu lingedza hafhu. U lingedza hafhu a hu iti hafhu nyito.
activity-recovery-empty: A hu na nḓivhadzo dza nyito dzi lindelaho.
activity-recovery-unavailable: A zwi ngo kona u ḽouda nḓivhadzo dza nyito dzi lindelaho.
activity-recovery-retrying: I khou khwinisa u swikisa ha nḓivhadzo…
activity-recovery-status-preparing: I khou lindela pulane ya muṱanganedzi
activity-recovery-status-processing: U vhulungela u swikisa hu khou shuma
activity-recovery-status-missing: Nyito ya u thoma a i tsheho
activity-recovery-status-changed: Nyito ya u thoma yo shanduka
activity-recovery-status-invalid: Metadata ya u vhuedzedza a yo ngo tea
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Pulane na nyito i lindelaho a zwi elani
activity-recovery-busy: Muṅwe mushumi u khou shuma nga nḓivhadzo iyi. Vusuludzani ni lingedze hafhu.
activity-recovery-denied: U swikela ha muṱanganedzi kana zwine a zwi takalela kha nḓivhadzo a zwi tsha tendela u swikisa.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Nyito ya u thoma a i tsheho kana yo shanduka. A hu na tsho itwaho hafhu.
activity-recovery-failed: A zwi ngo kona u fhedza u swikisa nḓivhadzo. Mushumo u lindelaho wo vhulungwa.
activity-recovery-paused: U swikisa nḓivhadzo dza nyito ho imiswa.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Nḓivhadzo iyi yo shanduka u bva tshee ya ḽoudiwa. Sedzulusani tshiimo tsho vusuludzwaho ni sa athu lingedza hafhu.
activity-recovery-control-failed: A zwi ngo kona u khwaṱhisedza nzudzanyo ya u swikisa. Vusuludzani ni sedzuluse tshiimo tshayo tsha zwino.
activity-recovery-status-cancelled: U swikisa nḓivhadzo dza nyito ho khanseliwa.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Khansela tshoṱhe u swikisa ho salaho ha nyito iyi? Izwi a zwi koni u bvelaphanḓa. Imeiḽi dzo no vha kha mutevhe na nḓivhadzo dzo no swikiswaho a dzi vhuiswi.
rule-email-recovery-heading: U swikiswa ha imeili dza milayo
rule-email-recovery-description: Sedzulusa ndingedzo dzo rekhodiwaho dza u rumela imeili dza milayo. Ndingedzo dzi sa athu khwaṱhisedzwa dzi nga vha dzi kha ḓi rumela kana dzo thithiswa. Muvhigo uyu a u dovhi wa rumela nahone a u khanseli u rumela.
rule-email-recovery-sent: Yo ṱanganedzwa nga seva ya imeili
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Mafhungo a ṱalusaho ndingedzo ha ngo tea
rule-email-recovery-identifiers: Zwiṱalusi zwa ndaela / u vhidza / ndingedzo
rule-email-recovery-empty: A hu na ndingedzo dza u rumela imeili dza milayo dzi elanaho na u ṱoḓa uhu.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: A zwi ngo kona u ḽouda ndingedzo dza imeiḽi dza milayo. Vusuludzani u lingedza hafhu.
rule-email-recovery-dropped: U rumela ho khanselwa nga mulanguli
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan a i dovhi ya rumela imeili i sa athu khwaṱhisedzwa nga yoṱhe. U dovha u rumela hu ya kha vhaṱanganedzi vha sa athu khwaṱhisedzwa fhedzi. I swayeni sa yo rumelwaho arali vha tshi ḓivha uri yo swika, kana vha khansele u i rumela.
rule-email-recovery-wait: U rumela ha u thoma hu nga vha hu kha ḓi bvela phanḓa. Vha nga dzhia tsheo nga murahu ha __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resends: U dovha u rumela ha kale: __count__
rule-email-recovery-resend: Dovhani vha rumele kha vhaṱanganedzi vha sa athu khwaṱhisedzwa
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Vha ṱoḓa u dovha u rumela imeili iyi kha vhaṱanganedzi vha sa athu khwaṱhisedzwa? Muthu muṅwe na muṅwe ane seva yawe ya imeili ya vha yo i ṱanganedza i songo ḓivhadza WeKan u ḓo i wana kavhili.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Vha ṱoḓa u swaya imeili iyi sa yo rumelwaho kha vhoṱhe? Vha ite zwenezwi fhedzi arali vha tshi ḓivha uri yo swika.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Vha ṱoḓa u khansela u rumela imeili iyi? A i nga rumelwi kha vhaṱanganedzi vha sa athu khwaṱhisedzwa.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: U rumela ha u thoma hu nga vha hu kha ḓi bvela phanḓa. Vha lingedze hafhu nga murahu.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: U dovha u rumela ha kale hu nga vha hu kha ḓi bvela phanḓa. Vha lingedze hafhu nga murahu.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Muṱanganedzi muṅwe na muṅwe o no khwaṱhisedzwa. Nṱhani hazwo, vha i swaye sa yo rumelwaho.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Seva ya imeili a yo ngo fhindula. Imeili yo dovha ya rumelwaho i nga vha yo swika kana i songo swika; i sumbedzwa sa i kha ḓi bvela phanḓa.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Muṅwe mulanguli u khou tandulula imeili iyi. Vha lingedze hafhu nga murahu ha tshifhinga tshiṱuku.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imeili yo vhulungwaho a i tsha tshimbilelana na ndingedzo iyi, ngauralo a i koni u tandululwa hafha.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Rekhodo yo vhulungwaho ya ndingedzo iyi a yo ngo tea, ngauralo a i koni u tandululwa hafha.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Zwo kundwa u tandulula imeili iyi. Vha vule siaṱari hafhu vha lingedze hafhu.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Imeili dza milayo dzo lindelaho tsedzuluso
rule-email-legacy-description: Imeili idzi dza milayo dzo dzudzanywa nga lushaka lwa kale lwa WeKan lu songo rekhodaho he zwi re ngomu ha bva hone, ngauralo WeKan a i nga dzi rumeli nga yoṱhe. Vha thome vha ṱole arali musiki wa mulayo a tshi kha ḓi vha na thendelo ya u swikelela, vha dovhe vha ṱumanye imeili u itela u i dzudzanya hafhu u bva kha garaṱa sa zwine ya vha zwone zwino, kana vha i laṱe.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Zwidodombedzwa zwa garaṱa zwi bvaho kha lushaka lwa kale
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Vha ṱoḓa u dzudzanya imeili iyi hafhu u bva kha garaṱa sa zwine ya vha zwone zwino? Zwi re ngomu zwi nga fhambana na zwe zwa dzudzanywa kale.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Vha ṱoḓa u laṱa imeili iyi? A i nga rumelwi na luthihi.
rule-email-legacy-empty: A hu na imeili dza milayo dzo lindelaho tsedzuluso.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Zwo kundwa u vula imeili dza milayo dzo lindelaho tsedzuluso. Vha vule siaṱari hafhu u itela u lingedza hafhu.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Musiki wa mulayo ha tsha vha na thendelo ya u swikelela garaṱa iyi, kana mulayo wo shanduka, ngauralo imeili a i koni u ṱumanywa hafhu. Vha nga i laṱa.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Nyito ye ya ita uri imeili iyi i dzudzanywe yo shanduka, ngauralo a i koni u ṱumanywa hafhu. Vha nga i laṱa.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Garaṱa ye imeili iyi ya bva khayo a i tsha wanala, ngauralo a i koni u ṱumanywa hafhu. Vha nga i laṱa.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: U tshimbidzwa ha mulayo he ha dzudzanya imeili iyi a hu tsha vha ho vhulungwa, ngauralo a i koni u ṱumanywa hafhu. Vha nga i laṱa.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Imeili iyi yo no rumelwa, yo no lingedzwa u rumelwa kana yo no laṱwa.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Imeili iyi yo no ṱumanywa hafhu.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Zwo kundwa u fhedza nyito iyi. Vha vule siaṱari hafhu vha lingedze hafhu.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Mishumo ya Sync ya Mutevhe i sa koni u dovhololwa
stuck-sync-operation-description: Muṅwe na muṅwe wa mishumo iyi yo vhulungwaho ya Sync ya Mutevhe wo ima vhukati nahone a u tsha kona u fhedzwa, ngauri mutevhe wawo wo bviswa, wa itwa hafhu kana wa dzudzanywa hafhu, kana mushumisi o u thomaho o xelelwa nga thendelo ya u ṅwala. Musi muthihi u tshi khou lindela, mutevhe uyo a u koni u ita Sync. U laṱeni uri mutevhe u kone u ita Sync hafhu: tshanduko dzo no shumiswaho dzi a dzula, tshanduko dzo vhulungwaho dzo salaho a dzi ṅwalwi, na Sync i tevhelaho i vhambedza mutevhe na tshisima tshawo hafhu.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Mutevhe wo bviswa, wa itwa hafhu kana nzudzanyo dzawo dza Sync dzo shanduka
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Mushumisi o u thomaho a tsha na thendelo ya u ṅwala kha mutevhe woṱhe
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Wo vhulungwa nga vesheni ya kale ya WeKan hu si na zwe zwa u thoma
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: Rekhodo ya we a u thoma a i tsheho
stuck-sync-operation-reason-unknown: A zwo ngo kona u sedzwa zwino
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: U nga dovhololwa hafhu zwino nahone u ḓo ḓifhedza, nga zwenezwo a u koni u laṱwa.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Laṱa mushumo uyu wo vhulungwaho wa Sync ya Mutevhe? Tshanduko dze wa dzi shumisa dzi a dzula; dzo salaho a dzi ṅwalwi. Mutevhe u nga kona u ita Sync hafhu.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: A hu na mishumo ya Sync ya Mutevhe i lindelaho u sedzuluswa.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Ho sumbedzwa ya kale ya 50 fhedzi. Laṱani miṅwe ni vusuludze u vhona minzhi.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: A zwi ngo kona u ḽouda mishumo ya Sync ya Mutevhe. Vusuludzani u lingedza hafhu.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: Mushumo uyu a u tsha lindela.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Mushumo uyu a wo ngo wanala wo ima, nga zwenezwo a u koni u laṱwa.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Mushumo uyu u nga dovhololwa hafhu zwino nahone u ḓo ḓifhedza, nga zwenezwo a wo ngo laṱwa.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Mutevhe uyu u khou ita Sync zwino. Lingedzani hafhu nga murahu ha tshifhinga tshiṱuku.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Zwo kundwa u fhedza nyito iyi. Vha vule siaṱari hafhu vha lingedze hafhu.
interrupted-import-heading: U dzhenisa ha bodo ho imaho hu sa athu fhela
interrupted-import-description: Muṅwe na muṅwe wa u dzhenisa uhu ha bodo wo ima vhukati - seva yo thoma hafhu, kana u dzhenisa ho kundelwa - ha sia bodo ya tshipiḓa. U dzhenisa a hu koni u bvelaphanḓa, ngauri faela ya tshisima tshayo a i vhulungwi. Vhulungani bodo nga he ya vha ngaho, kana ni i laṱe ni dzhenise faela hafhu. U laṱa hu bvisa bodo ye ya itwa nga u dzhenisa uhu na zwoṱhe zwi re khayo, hu tshi katelwa zwoṱhe zwo engedzwaho khayo u bva zwenezwo.
interrupted-import-state-stopped: Zwo ima zwi sa athu fhela, kha __stage__
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Zwi khou laṱwa; laṱani hafhu u fhedza
interrupted-import-scrum: Tshiṱaḓi tshayo tsha Scrum tshi na tshiṱoḓo tshatsho (__state__, __next__ kha __total__ dza maga). Arali na vhulunga bodo, fhedzani kana ni laṱe kha u vhuedzedza u dzhenisa ha Scrum ha bodo.
interrupted-import-counts: ḽaini dza __swimlanes__, mitevhe ya __lists__, khadi dza __cards__, mitevhe ya u sedza ya __checklists__, mihumbulo ya __comments__, zwiṱumetshedzwa zwa __attachments__
interrupted-import-no-board: A hu na bodo yo itwaho
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Vhulunga bodo iyi ya tshipiḓa nga he ya vha ngaho? A hu na tshi bviswaho, na u dzhenisa a hu tsha ṅwalwa fhano.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Laṱa u dzhenisa uhu? Bodo ye ha i ita na zwoṱhe zwi re khayo zwi bviswa tshoṱhe.
interrupted-import-empty: A hu na u dzhenisa ha bodo ho kanganyedzwaho hu lindelaho u sedzuluswa.
interrupted-import-truncated: Ho sumbedzwa ya kale ya 50 fhedzi. Vhulungani kana ni laṱe miṅwe ni vusuludze u vhona minzhi.
interrupted-import-unavailable: A zwi ngo kona u ḽouda u dzhenisa ha bodo ho kanganyedzwaho. Vusuludzani u lingedza hafhu.
interrupted-import-missing: U dzhenisa uhu a hu tsha rekhodiwa.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: U dzhenisa uhu a hu tsha lindela tsheo.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Bodo i re na id iyi a yo ngo itwa nga u dzhenisa uhu, nga zwenezwo a yo ngo kwamiwa.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Tshiṱaḓi tshayo tsha Scrum tshi kha ḓi khou ṅwalwa kana u vhuedzedzwa. Lingedzani hafhu nga murahu ha mimunithi i si gathi.
interrupted-import-failed: Zwo kundwa u fhedza nyito iyi. Vha vule siaṱari hafhu vha lingedze hafhu.
saml-login-not-started: U dzhena nga SAML a ho ngo thomiwa kha thebu iyi ya brauza. Ri humbela uri ni dovhe ni dzhene.
history-request-pending-undo: Seva a i athu u khwaṱhisedza u humisela murahu tshanduko yaṋu ya u fhedzisela.
history-request-pending-redo: Seva a i athu u khwaṱhisedza u dovha na ita tshanduko yaṋu ya u fhedzisela.
history-request-hint: U lingedza hafhu zwi dovholola khumbelo yeneyo, ngauralo zwi nga si vhuye zwa humisela murahu tshanduko ya vhuvhili.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: U vhuisa, u ita hafhu kana u vhuedzedza tshanduko dza Scrum ho ima nga nṱha ha khanedzano. U lulamisa ha Scrum kha bodo iyi ho thivhelwa u swika zwi tshi tandululwa.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Tshanduko dza __applied__ kha __total__ dzo ṅwalwa, __pending__ a dzo ngo ṅwalwa, na __conflicted__ dzo shandukiswa nga muṅwe muthu u bva zwenezwo.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: U vhuisa murahu hu vhuisa rekhodo iṅwe na iṅwe yo shandukaho nga he ya vha ngaho kale; hu ṋewa fhedzi musi hu si na muṅwe o shandukisaho rekhodo idzo u bva zwenezwo. U vhulunga bodo nga he ya vha ngaho hu bvisa mushumo wo imaho nahone a hu shandukisi rekhodo. Nga nḓila iṅwe na iṅwe, zwi rekhodiwa kha Phanele ya mulanguli, Thaidzo, U vhuedzedza.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard: Vhulunga bodo nga he ya vha ngaho
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Vhulunga rekhodo iṅwe na iṅwe nga he ya vha ngaho zwino, hu tshi katelwa tshanduko dze mushumo wo imaho wa dzi ṅwala?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Mulanguli wa bodo a nga i vhuisa murahu kana a vhulunga bodo nga he ya vha ngaho.
header-login: U dzhena nga ṱhoho dza HTTP
login-setting-clear-secret: Bvisani ndeme yo vhulungwaho kha phanele ya mulanguli
login-setting-after-restart: Zwi thoma u shuma musi WeKan yo thoma hafhu
login-setting-env-only: Mupo wa seva fhedzi u vhea izwi. Zwo sumbedzwa fhano sa zwa u vhala fhedzi.
email-to-card-description: Imeiḽi yo rumelwaho kha ḓiresi ya bodo yaṋu i vha garaṱa kha yeneyo bodo.
email-to-card-webhook: URL ya webhook i dzhenaho ya muṋetshedzi wa imeili (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark kana MIME relay i songo shumiswaho)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Zwo vhulungwa - litshani zwo ṱahala u zwi vhulunga
email-to-card-clear-secret: Bvisani tshiphiri tsha webhook tsho vhulungwaho
email-to-card-imap-accounts: Mabogisi a imeili a IMAP a u vhala
email-to-card-add-imap: Engedzani bogisi ḽa imeili ḽa IMAP
email-to-card-sandstorm-address: Ḓiresi ya imeili ya ino grain
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Bodo ine imeili ya ino grain ya ya khayo
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: A hu na - dzi-imeili fhedzi dzine dza vha na thokheni ya bodo kha ṱhoho
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Vhea izwi kha ṱhoho u swika kha ino bodo sa inwi:
email-to-card-swimlane: Nḓila ya mushumo ya garaṱa ntswa
email-to-card-parts: Zwipiḓa zwa imeili zwa u shumisa
email-to-card-part-strip-quoted: Litshani milaedza ya kale yo dzhielwaho
email-to-card-part-sender-line: Mutevhe wa murumeli nṱha ha ṱhaluso
email-to-card-your-address: Ḓiresi yaṋu ya imeili ya ino bodo
email-to-card-address-private: I vhulungeni yo dzumbama: muṅwe na muṅwe ane a vha nayo a nga engedza garaṱa sa inwi.
email-to-card-new-address: Ḓiresi ntswa (ya kale i ḓo litsha u shuma)
email-to-card-member-enabled: Ḓiresi dzanga dza bodo dzi a shuma
email-to-card-off-admin-off: U ṱanganedza imeili a zwo ngo dzudzanywa kha Phanele ya mulanguli.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Mulanguli wa bodo ha athu u bvula imeili kha ino bodo.
email-to-card-off-member-off: No dzima ḓiresi dzaṋu dza bodo kha Mivhea ya Miraḓo.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain a i athu u vha na ḓiresi yayo ya imeili. Hwalululani siaṱari.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Ni ṱoḓa thendelo ya u ṅwala kha ino bodo.
inbound-domain-invalid: Iḽo a si dzina ḽa domeini ḽo teaho.
inbound-domain-required: Ṋekedzani domeini ya ḓiresi dza bodo.
inbound-account-invalid: Bogisi ḽa imeili ḽa IMAP ḽi ṱoḓa dzina ḽa seva ḽo teaho.
feature-views-email-desc: Bodo sa bogisi ḽa poswo: mutevhe wa imeili ndi Bogisi ḽa zwi dzhenaho, mitevhe ndi dzifola, zwiswayo ndi zwiswayo, nahone miraḓo i ṅwala na u fhindula imeili i tshi bva kha ḓiresi ya bodo.
email-view-not-receiving: Ino bodo a i athu u ṱanganedza imeili. I thomeni kha Mavhekanyele a Nḓivhadzo a bodo → Imeiḽi kha garaṱa.
email-view-invalid-address: Iṅwe ya ḓiresi a si ḓiresi ya imeili yo teaho.
email-view-too-many-recipients: Vhaṱanganedzi vha 20 fhedzi kha mulaedza muthihi.
email-view-too-many: Ho rumelwa dzimeili nnzhi vhukuma kha awara yo fhiraho. Lingedzani hafhu nga murahu.
email-view-no-list: Bodo i ṱoḓa mutevhe wa imeili.
email-view-send-failed: Imeili a yo ngo kona u rumelwa.
feature-views-chat-desc: Bodo sa fhethu ha mushumo ha nyambedzano: fhethu ha mushumo, dzibodo, nḓila, mitevhe na garaṱa sa muri wa zwiteshi, garaṱa vhukati na mihumbulo yayo sa milaedza ya nyambedzano.
chat-view-message-cards: Sumbedzani fhedzi garaṱa dzi re na milaedza
chat-view-pick-card: Nangani garaṱa kha zwiteshi u i vhona fhano.
chat-view-no-messages: A hu athu u vha na milaedza. Ṅwalani wa u thoma.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Garaṱa dzi fanaho kha zwigwada zwinzhi zwa kholomu zwi re na madzina - nga u fhedza, ndeme, tshiga kana tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe - dzi tshi tshimbidzwa vhukati ha kholomu nga u kokodza.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menyu ya bodo → Milayo i themendela milayo u bva kha zwine vhathu vha zwi ita nga tshanḓa tshifhinga tshoṱhe.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menyu ya bodo → Manweledzo i sumbedza zwe muthu muṅwe na muṅwe a zwi ita kha bodo nga ḓuvha kana vhege ya u fhedza, na zwo fhiriwaho nga tshifhinga.
feature-since-last-visit: U bva musi ni tshi dalela lwa u fhedza
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menyu ya bodo → U bva musi ni tshi dalela lwa u fhedza i sumbedza zwe vhaṅwe vha zwi shandukisa kha bodo.
feature-search-phrases-desc: U ṱoḓa hoṱhe hu pfesesa mitaladzo i ngaho "dzikarata dzanga dzo fhiriwaho nga tshifhinga".
column-sets-empty: A hu athu u vha na zwigwada zwa kholomu. Mulanguli wa bodo a nga ita tshithihi: tshi ṋeni dzina, ni engedze kholomu dzatsho.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Bodo sa tshitevheli tsha thaidzo dza GitHub kana Gitea: garaṱa sa thaidzo, dziḽeibuḽu na zwiṱaraṱa, mahumbulwa sa nyambedzano, zwiṱumetshedzwa sa faela, na ḓivhazwakale ya bodo na u vhuisela murahu.
vcs-no-due-date: A hu na ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza
vcs-no-issues: A hu na thaidzo i tshimbilelanaho na u ṱoḓa uhu.
vcs-no-milestones: A hu na zwiṱaraṱa zwazwino. Ḽeibuḽu ḽi re na ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza ndi tshiṱaraṱa.
vcs-no-description: A hu na ṱhaluso yo ṋetshedzwaho.
vcs-no-list: Bodo iyi a i na mutevhe kana nḓila ya thaidzo.
card-qr-code-desc: I sikeneni u itela u vula garaṱa iyi kha founu kana thebuleti.
card-qr-code-too-long: Vhukwamani ha garaṱa iyi vhu lapfesa kha khoudu ya QR.
vcs-no-releases: A hu athu u vha na zwo bviswaho.
vcs-no-wiki: A hu athu u vha na wiki. U dzhenisa dzangano ḽa GitHub zwi ḓisa wiki ya tshivhulungi tsha khoudu fhano.
github-org-import-desc: Tshivhulungi tsha khoudu tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha dzangano kana mushumisi tshi vha bodo yatsho, i vulwaho kha Board View / Version Control: thaidzo dzatsho na mahumbulwa, dziḽeibuḽu na faela, zwo bviswaho zwatsho, nḓila dza mushumo dza GitHub Actions sa Milayo, na wiki yatsho.
github-org-import-token-hint: I a ṱoḓea kha zwivhulungi zwa khoudu zwa tshiphiri na mukano wa API wa nṱha. I shumiswa fhedzi musi u dzhenisa hu tshi khou itea nahone a i vhulungwi na luthihi.
github-org-import-issues: Thaidzo, na mahumbulwa, dziḽeibuḽu na faela
github-org-import-release-files: Faela dza zwo bviswaho (dzi nga vha khulwane)
github-org-import-actions: Nḓila dza mushumo dza GitHub Actions sa Milayo
github-org-import-result: thaidzo %s, zwo bviswaho %s, milayo %s, masiaṱari a wiki %s
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Ṅwalani dzina ḽa dzangano kana mushumisi, kana diresi yaḽo ya GitHub.
github-org-import-no-repos: A hu na zwivhulungi zwa khoudu zwa u dzhenisa.
github-org-import-running: U dzhenisa dzangano hu khou itea kale.
optional-apis-desc: Dzi-API dza REST dzo fanaho na dzi-API dza zwiṅwe zwishumiswa zwa u tevhela, uri dziapp na zwikiripiti zwadzo zwi kone u shumisa WeKan iyi sa backend yadzo: zwine dza zwi vhulunga zwi vhulungwa kha WeKan, kha bodo dza WeKan. Iṅwe na iṅwe yo valwa u swika i tshi swayiwa fhano. A hu na na nthihi i re na pfanelo dzayo: mushumisi (client) u dzhena nga token ya WeKan API nahone a nga vhona na u shandukisa zwine muthu onoyo a nga zwi vhona na u zwi shandukisa kha WeKan fhedzi. Dzoṱhe dzi ṱoḓa uri WeKan REST API i vhe yo vulwa (WITH_API=true). Diresi i re fhasi ha iṅwe na iṅwe ndi ine mushumisi a i shumisa sa seva yawe.
optional-api-trello-desc: Dziapp na zwikiripiti zwo ṅwalelwaho REST API ya Trello (sa tsumbo Trellinator) zwi shuma na WeKan: bodo, mitevhe, garaṱa, dziḽeibuḽu, miraḓo, mahumbulwa na mitevhe ya u sedza. Token ya Trello ndi token ya WeKan API. U bvisa garaṱa zwi i vhulunga kha WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Vhashumisi vha REST API v2 ya Jira vha shuma na WeKan: thandela ndi bodo (khii yayo ndi khii ya bodo), thaidzo ndi garaṱa (DEV-7), tshiimo ndi mutevhe, nahone u pfukela zwi tshimbidza garaṱa. U ṱoḓa zwi ṱanganedza JQL i leluwaho: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text na ORDER BY. Dzhenani nga token ya WeKan API sa phasiwede. U bvisa thaidzo zwi i vhulunga.
optional-api-github-desc: Vhashumisi vha REST API ya GitHub ya thaidzo vha shuma na WeKan: vhuvhulungelo (repository) ndi bodo, thaidzo ndi garaṱa, na dziḽeibuḽu, zwiṱaraṱa (dziḽeibuḽu dzi re na ḓuvha ḽa u fhela), mahumbulwa, na zwo vulea kana zwo valwa sa kha Mbonalo ya bodo / Ndaulo ya Vesheni. Token ndi token ya WeKan API.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Vhashumisi vha REST API ya Gitea na Forgejo ya thaidzo vha shuma na WeKan, nga nḓila i fanaho na API i tshimbilelanaho na GitHub: vhuvhulungelo ndi bodo nahone thaidzo ndi garaṱa. Token ndi token ya WeKan API.
bots-none: A hu na dzibothi zwazwino. Bothi ndi mushumi kha seva yaṋu - muimeleli wa AI, mushumo wa CI, sikiripiti - ane bodo heyi ya mu ṋea garaṱa.
bots-no-runs: A huna bothi ḽi shumaho zwino.
bots-summary: %s zwi khou shuma · %s zwi khou ni lindela
bot-not-found: Bothi iḽo a ḽi kha bodo heyi.
bot-option-not-found: Phindulo iyo a si iṅwe ya dze bothi ḽa ṋea.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhook dzi bvaho a dzi koni u swika kha diresi dza netiweke ya WeKan nga yoṱhe, uri hu si vhe na muthu ane a nga livhisa webhook ya bodo kha tshumelo ya nga ngomu. Ṅwalani fhano dziseva dza kha yeneyo netiweke dzine webhook dza nga dzi swika - Node-RED, seva ya u davhidzana - nthihi kha mutevhe muṅwe na muṅwe, sa dzina kana diresi, na phothe u itela u tendela yeneyo phothe fhedzi. Hu si na tshithu: na nthihi. Ndi vhalanguli vha saithi fhedzi vhane vha nga shandukisa uyu mutevhe.
account-webhook: Webhook ya u dzhena na u ḓiṅwalisa
account-webhook-desc: Ḽiresi ḽithihi ḽine WeKan ya ḽi vhudza musi muthu a tshi dzhena kana akhaunthu ntswa i tshi itwa. A hu na tshi rumelwaho u swika tshiitea tshi re afho fhasi tsho swaywa. Tshi hwala tshiitea, Dzina ḽa mushumisi na tshifhinga; swayani zwipiḓa zwiṅwe arali muṱanganedzi a tshi zwi ṱoḓa fhedzi.
account-webhook-on-register: Musi akhaunthu ntswa i tshi itwa
account-webhook-field-ip: Ḽiresi ḽa IP ḽe u dzhena ha bva khaḽo
webhook-internal-hosts-rejected: A si seva, a yo ngo vhulungwa:
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Fhelisa ndivhadzo dzoṱhe dzi kha ḓi lindela dza mishumo ya kale u fhira maḓuvha mangana?
activity-recovery-bulk-result: Dzo fheliswa %s, dzo rumelwa %s, %s dza kale dzi kha ḓi lindela.
vcs-synced-from: Yo elaniswa u bva kha %s: i vuleni na u i vala henefho.
vcs-synced-issue: Thaidzo iyi yo elaniswa: i vuleni na u i vala kha tshitoli tshayo.
sync-write-back: Ṅwalani tshanduko murahu kha GitLab: ṱhoho, ṱhaluso, mihumbulo, u vala na u vula hafhu
sync-write-back-error: U ṅwala murahu kha GitLab ho kundelwa
email-bounces-description: Zwine WeKan ya ita nga imeili i vhuyaho: ḓiresi yo ṅwalwaho nga vhukhakhi, bogisi ḽa poswo ḽo ḓalaho, phindulo ya u sa vha ofisini, mbilaelo ya spam. Lushaka luṅwe na luṅwe lu na zwiito zwaḽo, zwine zwa itwa musi yo vhuya lwonolwo.
email-bounces-enabled: Langa dziimeili dzo vhuyaho kha WeKan
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Litsha u rumela imeili kha ḓiresi
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Ḓiresi a i hone: vhukhakhi ha u ṅwala, akhaunthu yo phumulwaho, domeini i sa ḓivhiwi.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: A i athu u swikiswa zwino: bogisi ḽo ḓala, seva yo farakanea. Nnzhi dzi tevhekanaho fhedzi ndi dzine dza vha na zwine dza amba.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Phindulo dza u sa vha ofisini, ḽiholodo kana sisiṱeme ya thikithi. Imeili yo swikiswa.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Muṱanganedzi o swaya imeili sa spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Kha Amazon SES, rumelani nḓivhadzo dza Bounce na Complaint, na mulayo wa u ṱanganedza wa ḓiresi ine WeKan ya rumela khayo, kha thero ya SNS, ni ṅwalise ḓiresi iyi khayo nga HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: Dzi-ARN dza thero dza SNS dzine dza ṱanganedzwa, nthihi nga mutalo
email-bounces-stopped-only: Ḓiresi fhedzi dzine WeKan a i tsha dzi rumela imeili
email-bounces-clear-hint: Hangwa u vhuya ha ḓiresi iyi ni i rumele imeili hafhu
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Hezwi a si ARN ya thero ya SNS.
email-bounces-providers-description: Arali WeKan i tshi rumela nga kha iṅwe ya tshumelo idzi, i shumiseni, ni ṋee tshumelo iyo ḓiresi iyi ya webhook ya zwiitea zwayo zwa dziimeili dzo vhuyaho na mbilaelo dza spam, ni nambatedze fhano khii ine ya zwi saina ngayo, kana phasiwede ye na i vhea kha ḓiresi sa https://user:password@… kana ?secret=…
email-bounces-provider-key: Khii ya u saina ya webhook
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Tshumelo yo vulwaho i ṱoḓa khii yayo ya u saina kana phasiwede.
activity-pub-enabled: Dzibodo dza tshitshavha dzi andadza mishumo ya garaṱa dzadzo kha fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Yo dzimwa u bva mathomoni. Musi yo vulwa, bodo iṅwe na iṅwe ya tshitshavha i nga tevhelwa u bva kha Mastodon na maseva maṅwe a fediverse sa @board-<id> kha diresi ya WeKan iyi, nahone mishumo miswa ya garaṱa i swika kha vhatevheli vhayo. Ndi ya u vhala fhedzi: a hu na tshithu tshine seva ya fediverse ya tshi rumela tsha shandukisa bodo, nahone dzibodo dza tshiphiri a dzi nga ḓo andadzwa.
caldav-sync-desc: Vhea maḓuvha a u fhedza a garaṱa dza bodo iyi kha khalenda - Nextcloud Calendar kana khalenda iṅwe na iṅwe ya CalDAV. Ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza ḽo shandukiswaho kha khalenda ḽi vhuyelela kha garaṱa. Shumisani phasiwede ya aplikheisheni, hu si yaṋu.
caldav-enabled: Ṱanganyani maḓuvha a u fhedza na khalenda iyi
caldav-invalid-url: Diresi ya khalenda i fanela u vha diresi ya http:// kana https://, i si na dzina ḽa mushumisi kana phasiwede.
caldav-not-linked: Tshi thoma vhulungani diresi ya khalenda nahone ni vule u ṱanganya.
webdav-storage-description: Vhulungani zwiṱumetshedzwa kha folodo kha seva ya WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud kana iṅwe. Shumisani phasiwede ya aplikheisheni yo itelwaho WeKan. Seva i re kha netiweke ya WeKan yone iṋe i nga shumiswa fhano, ngauri ndi mulanguli wa saithi fhedzi ane a vhea diresi iyi.
sqrl-desc: Zwo dzimiwa u bva mathomoni. Musi zwo dzhiswa, siaṱari ḽa u dzhena ḽi ṋea SQRL, nahone miraḓo i thoma u engedza vhuvhili havho ha SQRL kha Nzudzanyo dza muraḓo. SQRL i ṱoḓa WeKan kha ḓiresi ya https://.
sqrl-scan: Sekenani khoudu nga apuḽikheshini yaṋu ya SQRL, kana vulani khiḽaini yaṋu ya SQRL kha tshishumiswa itshi.
sqrl-expired: Khoudu iyi ya SQRL yo fhela tshifhinga. Thomani hafhu.
sqrl-sign-in-failed: U dzhena nga SQRL ho kundelwa.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL i ṱoḓa WeKan kha ḓiresi ya https://.
sqrl-description: Dzhenani nga vhuvhili haṋu ha SQRL nṱhani ha phasiwede. Hu engedzeni fhano luthihi nga khiḽaini yaṋu ya SQRL; ni nga hu bvisa fhano tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe.
sqrl-added: Vhuvhili haṋu ha SQRL ho engedzwa.
sqrl-none: A hu na vhuvhili ha SQRL ho engedzwaho.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: U dzhena nga SQRL ho dzimiwa kha akhaunthu iyi u bva kha khiḽaini yaṋu ya SQRL. Hu dzhiseni hafhu henefho nga khoudu yaṋu ya u tshidza.
sqrl-only-on: Khiḽaini yaṋu ya SQRL yo hadzimela akhaunthu iyi kha SQRL fhedzi: nḓila dzoṱhe dzińwe dza u dzhena dzi a hanelwa.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Khiḽaini yaṋu ya SQRL yo hadzimela akhaunthu iyi nga u khwaṱha: u vhea hafhu phasiwede na u shandukisa imeiḽi zwi a hanelwa.
sqrl-only: Akhaunthu iyi i dzhena nga SQRL fhedzi.
sqrl-hardlock: Akhaunthu iyi yo hadzimelwa kha SQRL: a i koni u wanulusiwa kana u shandukiswa nga iṅwe nḓila.
windows-sso-failed: U dzhena nga Windows a zwo ngo konadzea. Akhaunthu yaṋu ya Windows i nga kha ḓi sa tendelwi fhano.
blockly-TOOLBOX_SEARCH_NO_RESULTS: A hu na bulogo dzi tshimbilelanaho dzo wanalaho
